question: For $A=\begin{bmatrix}2&-1\\3&4\end{bmatrix}$, find the cofactor of each element and form the corresponding cofactor matrix.
explanation:
Cofactors of the first row
Using $A_{ij}=(-1)^{i+j}M_{ij}$, $$A_{11}=4$$ and $$A_{12}=-3$$
Cofactors of the second row
The remaining cofactors are $$A_{21}=-(-1)=1$$ and $$A_{22}=2$$
Formation of the cofactor matrix
Arranging the calculated cofactors in their corresponding positions gives $$\begin{bmatrix}A_{11}&A_{12}\\A_{21}&A_{22}\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}4&-3\\1&2\end{bmatrix}$$
Sign-pattern verification
The signs follow the arrangement $\begin{bmatrix}+&-\\-&+\end{bmatrix}$. Hence, the required cofactor matrix is $\begin{bmatrix}4&-3\\1&2\end{bmatrix}$.
